merge-studio.html.title: Start with a sample
merge-studio.html.text: Click Load sample to fill in a spreadsheet and a template, then watch the preview change as you explore.

merge-studio.html.title: Your data
merge-studio.html.text: Drop a CSV or Excel file here, or paste a table. Each row becomes one document. Untick rows to skip them, or type a filter like Status = "Active".

merge-studio.html.title: The template
merge-studio.html.text: Write your letter with {{Column Name}} wherever data should go. ? Syntax lists tables ({{#each}}), conditions and filters.

merge-studio.html.title: Live preview
merge-studio.html.text: Shows the record you are on. Step through records with the arrows, or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>.

merge-studio.html.title: Checks
merge-studio.html.text: Flags missing columns or empty values before you generate. Click it for details.

merge-studio.html.title: PDF tab
merge-studio.html.text: The real PDF, exactly as it will download. Page size, fonts, logo, header and footer are under Page setup.

merge-studio.html.title: Download
merge-studio.html.text: One PDF for this record, a zip of all of them, one combined PDF, or Email drafts (.eml) with the PDF attached.

pdf-studio.html.title: Add files
pdf-studio.html.text: Drop PDFs, images, Word, PowerPoint or Excel files here. Nothing is uploaded; it all runs in your browser.

pdf-studio.html.title: Your files
pdf-studio.html.text: Reorder, and remove files you do not need. Operations use this list.

pdf-studio.html.title: Pick an operation
pdf-studio.html.text: Merge, split, organize pages, watermark, convert and more. Choosing one opens its options below.

pdf-studio.html.title: Options and pages
pdf-studio.html.text: In the page organizer you can drag pages to reorder, rotate them or remove them.

pdf-studio.html.title: Save
pdf-studio.html.text: When it finishes, the result appears here ready to download.

mermaid-live.html.title: Write the diagram
mermaid-live.html.text: Type Mermaid syntax on the left; the diagram redraws as you type.

mermaid-live.html.title: Themes
mermaid-live.html.text: Switch the look of the rendered diagram.

mermaid-live.html.title: Pan and zoom
mermaid-live.html.text: Drag the diagram to pan and scroll to zoom. Double-click to fit it all.

mermaid-live.html.title: Folders of diagrams
mermaid-live.html.text: Open a folder to work on a set of .mmd files, saved to disk as real files.

mermaid-live.html.title: Export
mermaid-live.html.text: Save as PNG or SVG, or copy a PNG to the clipboard.

regex-studio.html.title: Pattern and flags
regex-studio.html.text: Type your regular expression and toggle the flags (global, ignore case, multiline...).

regex-studio.html.title: Test text
regex-studio.html.text: Matches are highlighted live as you edit the pattern or the text.

regex-studio.html.title: Explanation
regex-studio.html.text: A plain-English breakdown of what each part of the pattern does.

regex-studio.html.title: Test cases
regex-studio.html.text: Add strings that should match or not, and see PASS / FAIL at a glance.

regex-studio.html.title: Replace
regex-studio.html.text: Try a replacement using $1, $<name> or $& and see the result below.
